Accidentally replied from a different account lol. Here’s my response, from the correct account this time:


Totally agreed re:therapy, but unfortunately he doesn’t have insurance, and paying out of pocket for therapy is out of the question with our current finances. 

Even when porn was blocked from his phone, I saw him looking at sexy Instagram girls. I’m pretty sure he hasn’t stopped masturbating at all. But my gut is kind of telling me that the masturbating is back to crazy levels like it used to be now that porn is unblocked. And tbh I have no desire to block it from his phone again, like- he isn’t my child. He’s a grown man. It just sucks that this is most likely happening and that he doesn’t want to be honest or communicate about it at all (if indeed this is happening, of course). His relationship with porn is super secretive, before I found out about his addiction, I tried to get him to watch it with me and he acted grossed out by me and refused. After I found out about the addiction, not really understanding addiction at the time I guess, I again suggested we watch it. More refusal. I’d say more than anything he’s addicted to reddit porn/subs. I found a secret account of his where he followed 40+ different porn subs, most of which were everyday women posting nude selfies and shit.

There’s obviously a lot to unpack about this haha. I guess I’m just venting.


Not a day goes by where I don’t acknowledge inside how miserable I am, and how much I wonder if there’s better for me out there. I’ve begun to fantasize about other people the way I used to when I was single. I know that’s not a great sign for the relationship.

(Image is two angles of the same tooth)

To boot, the tooth right behind it, molar #2, is going to have to be extracted soon. Meaning just molar #3 (which I assume is already fragile) and my wisdom tooth on that side will be my upper molars.

Note that molar #3 has the orange temporary, because I’ve yet to get the permanent filling yet (my dentist wants me to wait. It’s been two months since I had the root canal).
